Name: WaterCanRefiller
Author: Mizzion
Description:
This mod slowly refills your Watering Can in wet Weather (Rain, Snow, Lightning).


[b]Config Options[/b]
[list]
ModEnabled = Turns the mod on or off.WaterCanMustBeHeld = Whether or not the player must be holding the water can for it to be refilled.ShowWaterLevel = Whether or not to show the Water Level in game.[/list]

[b]Hot Keys[/b]:
[b]F5[/b] - reloads the config file while in the game.



[i]To modify the configuration file, please run the game at least once. The config file will be created.[/i]

Downloads.Description: Updated for SDV 1.6 and fixed bugs.
